summary: Build SQL, Python, PostgreSQL, and workflow orchestration skills through guided data pipeline exercises. Explore the 10-day course.
lede: Data engineering builds dependable pipelines that prepare data for reporting and operational decisions. For data analysts, database practitioners, and IT operations professionals, this course provides foundational practice extracting data with SQL and PostgreSQL, transforming it with Python, building dbt models, orchestrating workflows with Apache Airflow, and checking data quality.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who build, support, or depend on data pipelines and workflow automation. It suits foundation-level learners who want guided practice with SQL, Python, and core data engineering tools. This course is designed for: Data analysts who prepare source data for repeatable reporting. Database administrators who manage PostgreSQL tables, access, and data extracts. Junior data engineers who build foundational ingestion and transformation pipelines. ETL developers who maintain SQL and Python data workflows. Data integration specialists who connect APIs and structured data sources. Business intelligence developers who model clean datasets for dashboards. Data quality analysts who define checks for completeness and accuracy. IT operations engineers who schedule and monitor Apache Airflow workflows. Analytics managers who scope pipeline work and review delivery risks. Data governance practitioners who document ownership, lineage, and access controls.
modules: Git and Data Pipeline Change Control
Data Storage and Apache Kafka Concepts
prerequisites: You should be comfortable using a computer and working with files or spreadsheets. The guided labs include basic SQL and Python editing, so you should be ready to practise both; a laptop and access to the provided training environment are required.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
